testing_gaps: device/tests/test_camera_isp_quality.py does not exercise adaptive sensor gain on a dark frame containing bright paper; a mocked _capture_batch_adaptive test should verify the new peak-based cap prevents a gain-increasing recapture when highlights are already near saturation.

The calibrated production path is not covered end to end: test_camera_isp_quality.py checks malformed/missing calibration and _apply_color_gains directly, but never opens a valid calibration and captures. Add a valid temporary calibration test asserting stored gains, sensor exposure/gain, and decoded JPEG color on a synthetic white/pale-yellow page; this guards against production silently using neutral gains while the helper test still passes.

The new highlight cap in _capture_batch_adaptive has no behavioral test. Add a mocked dark batch containing a near-white patch and assert no higher-gain recapture, plus a uniformly dark batch that does raise gain; this proves shadow compensation preserves bright paper details at the sensor stage as well as in _digital_exposure.
The new _v4l2 cleanup branch has no timeout/cancellation test verifying that a running child is killed and reaped while the original timeout or cancellation propagates.
